Samuel — thanks for the flag and the context. We can accommodate a two-week shift but want to lock in clear actions so the slip doesn't cascade. Proposed immediate steps: 

1) Interim containment (this week): enable cross-region failover for the pilot and pin a KV-cache snapshot cadence (daily) — engineering can toggle this; ETA 48 hrs.
2) MAP update (deliverable by 2026-07-12): revise milestones (pilot sign-off, soft-go-live, full acceptance) with owner and acceptance criteria.
3) Credit/contingency: offer a one-week service credit if acceptance slips beyond 2026-08-03 unless the delay is due to outstanding Redwood deliverables.
4) Short soft-go-live: we can run a reduced-scope soft-go-live on 2026-07-27 (read-only evaluation) if your security team accepts the containment config.

Ben — looping you in for the commercial/credit language. Samuel — can you confirm stakeholders for sign-off (security PO owner + product acceptor) and whether procurement will push the PO this week? Once you confirm, I'll publish an amended MAP and a risk log entry.

Regards,
Karthik
